decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component sprayer extends the firm's core spraying expertise into heavy corrosion protection, has been on the website continuously since 2023, and has had too little time to justify abandoning the investment.

The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a publicized field test on a construction site, so it is a visible public commitment close to the core business that management will defend and develop further.
As a multi-model product line building on established conveying know-how, the transfer pump represents substantial sunk development and production investment that management will persist with.

The fire protection flow monitoring fits the firm's announced digitalized, interoperable direction and has its own dedicated page, so any weak early results would likely be attributed to market ramp-up rather than failure.
The hydraulic two-component sprayer was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core offer, so dropping it within a year is very unlikely.
